```{=html}
<div class="resonance-explorer" data-resonance-explorer aria-label="Interactive demonstration of Doppler tuning of a nuclear resonance">
  <div class="resonance-controls">
    <div class="resonance-control-heading">
      <strong>Angle between the \(B^*\) recoil and the photon</strong>
      <output data-resonance-angle>\(\theta=90^\circ\) — the photon is emitted perpendicular to the recoil</output>
    </div>

    <div class="resonance-slider-row">
      <span>along the recoil</span>
      <input
        type="range"
        min="0"
        max="180"
        value="90"
        step="1"
        data-resonance-slider
        aria-label="Angle between the momentum of the excited nucleus and the photon momentum"
      >
      <span>against the recoil</span>
      <button type="button" class="resonance-fire-button" data-resonance-fire>
        <span aria-hidden="true">▶</span> Emit a photon
      </button>
    </div>

    <div class="resonance-slider-scale" aria-hidden="true">
      <span>\(0^\circ\)</span>
      <span>\(90^\circ\)</span>
      <span>\(180^\circ\)</span>
    </div>
  </div>

  <div class="resonance-stage" data-resonance-stage>
    <div class="resonance-flight-line"></div>

    <div class="resonance-absorber" data-resonance-absorber>
      <span class="resonance-nucleus-label resonance-ground-label">\(B\)</span>
      <span class="resonance-nucleus-label resonance-excited-label">\(B^*\)</span>
      <small>absorber at rest</small>
    </div>

    <div class="resonance-source" data-resonance-source>
      <span class="resonance-nucleus-label resonance-ground-label">\(B\)</span>
      <span class="resonance-nucleus-label resonance-excited-label">\(B^*\)</span>
      <small>source</small>
    </div>

    <div class="resonance-source-momentum" data-resonance-vector>
      <i></i>
    </div>
    <div class="resonance-momentum-label">\(\mathbf p_{B^*}\): the direction varies, the magnitude is fixed by the neutrino</div>

    <div class="resonance-test-photon" data-resonance-photon>\(\gamma\)</div>
    <div class="resonance-absorption-flash"></div>

    <div class="resonance-direction-note">
      \(\mathbf p_\gamma\) always points to the left, toward the absorber
      <span aria-hidden="true">←</span>
    </div>
  </div>

  <div class="resonance-readout">
    <div class="resonance-energy-heading">
      <strong>Photon energy in the absorber rest frame</strong>
      <span data-resonance-energy-text>\(E_\gamma<E_{\rm res}\) — not enough energy</span>
    </div>

    <div class="resonance-energy-scale">
      <div class="resonance-energy-window">
        <span>nominal window: \(\lvert E_\gamma-E_\gamma^{\rm abs}\rvert&lt;0.10\,\mathrm{eV}\)</span>
      </div>
      <div class="resonance-energy-marker" data-resonance-energy-marker>
        <span>\(E_\gamma\)</span>
      </div>
    </div>

    <div class="resonance-energy-labels">
      <span>below</span>
      <span>\(E_\gamma^{\rm abs}\)</span>
      <span>above</span>
    </div>
  </div>

  <div class="resonance-outcome" data-resonance-outcome>
    At \(\theta=90^\circ\) the photon passes through the absorber.
  </div>
</div>
```
